sourceText:
First Snickerdoodles
By: Harpie
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 1:53am

Ingredients




1 cup Flour
1 teaspoon Cream of Tartar
1 teaspoon Baking Soda
1 teaspoon Nutmeg
1 teaspoon Salt
8 tablespoons Unsalted Butter (marg/short), at room temp
3/4 cup +⅓ cup Sugar
1 Egg
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
1 teaspoon Cinnamon

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine flour, cream of tartar, soda, nutmeg, and salt. 2 With an electric mixer at medium-low speed, cream the butter and 3/4 cup sugar until light and fluffy. Reduce speed to low and beat in flour mixture until well blended.  3 Combine cinnamon and remaining 1/3 cup sugar. Roll dough in to 1-inch balls, then roll in cinnamon mixture. Place on ungreased baking sheet about 2 inches apart and bake until lightly browned, about 10 min. 4 Options: Replace cinnamon mixture with: finely chopped nuts, sprinkles, coloured sugar crystals, tiny colour chocolate chips, etc.

About


30 Min - Work Time
40 Min - Total Time

Comments:
Harpie

Hello: I cleaned up the ingredients list a bit. Many of the ingredients didn't include an actual quantity, so I changed them all to 1s (except the sugar, which is specified as 3/4 cup in the instructions). You might want to double check the quantities to ensure they are correct.
Also, the ingredients list includes egg and vanilla extract, but neither are included in the instructions. At which point should they be incorporated in your recipe?
